title: CHANGES_REQUESTED follow-up: background effects, manual actions, evidence and installer

p0_a_background_effects.defect: PurchaseCompletionActions.retry_saved_statuses iterated every workflow item, so a SAVED order outside the scope could cause a Google status write and a local state change
fix: PurchaseCompletionActions accepts inquiry_ids; retry_saved_statuses uses the filtered set
process() refuses results outside the scope before any write
explicit inquiry_ids conflicting with RunScope is refused (SCOPE_INQUIRY_IDS_CONFLICT)

p0_c_manual_actions.defect: start_login_all_sites was gated on the google write permission, so an approved google target reopened the unscoped sweep
fix: start_login_all_sites refuses in preview or in any enforced scope, independent of write permission
_action_in_scope audits each action against the required module and every write family it reaches
edit requires google (it writes a cell); purchase requires inso and google; quotation/tp refused
can_order_action and request_order_action use the audit and explain the refusal
